text.title: The Question Before the Mechanism
text.body:
Planetary systems can model and act while displacing the subject for whom distinctions matter. The essay therefore begins at the formal limit: can an intelligence make the horizon from which it acts available to reflection? The mechanism enters only after the argument derives what attunement requires.

text.title: Definition as Cut, Gift, and Danger
text.body:
Determination is negational and productive: it gives a knowable object by distinguishing it from what it is not, yet becomes dangerous when the achieved term forgets the field and activity from which it was cut.
